source_grounding.source_excerpt: lib/collection/src/optimizers_builder.rs:75-84 (OptimizersConfig, create/describe face): "/// Maximum size (in kilobytes) of vectors allowed for plain index, exceeding this threshold will enable vector indexing /// /// Default value is 10,000, based on experiments and observations. /// /// To disable vector indexing, set to `0`. /// /// Note: 1kB = 1 vector of size 256. #[serde(alias = "indexing_threshold_kb")] #[serde(default)] pub indexing_threshold: Option<usize>," | lib/collection/src/operations/config_diff.rs:148-156 (OptimizersConfigDiff, PATCH-update face): "/// Maximum size (in kilobytes) of vectors allowed for plain index, exceeding this threshold will enable vector indexing /// /// Default value is 20,000, based on <https://github.com/google-research/google-research/blob/master/scann/docs/algorithms.md>. /// /// To disable vector indexing, set to `0`. /// /// Note: 1kB = 1 vector of size 256. #[serde(alias = "indexing_threshold_kb")] pub indexing_threshold: Option<usize>," | config_diff.rs:270-272 update impl: "indexing_threshold: indexing_threshold.or(self.indexing_threshold)," (omitted diff member preserves current value; no default fn attached) | lib/shard/src/optimizers/config.rs:15: "pub const DEFAULT_INDEXING_THRESHOLD_KB: usize = 10_000;" and :176-182: "pub fn get_indexing_threshold_kb(indexing_threshold: Option<usize>) -> usize { match indexing_threshold { None => DEFAULT_INDEXING_THRESHOLD_KB, Some(0) => usize::MAX, Some(custom) => custom } }" | lib/storage/src/content_manager/collection_meta_ops.rs:162 and :277: both CreateCollection and UpdateCollection carry "pub optimizers_config: Option<OptimizersConfigDiff>" | grpc mirror of the 20,000 sentence: lib/api/src/grpc/proto/collections.proto:291, lib/api/src/grpc/qdrant.rs:838.
source_grounding.call_chain_traced: The field-level doc comments on OptimizersConfig (optimizers_builder.rs:77, 'Default value is 10,000') and OptimizersConfigDiff (config_diff.rs:150, 'Default value is 20,000') are the JsonSchema descriptions rendered into the served OpenAPI for the describe/readback vs create/update request faces (both structs derive JsonSchema; the REST create/update bodies reference Option<OptimizersConfigDiff> in collection_meta_ops.rs). At runtime the diff's indexing_threshold is Option<usize> with serde default None and NO custom default fn, so an omitted member on create/PATCH deserializes to None; OptimizersConfig::update applies indexing_threshold.or(self.indexing_threshold) (config_diff.rs:271) so PATCH preserves the current value and never materializes any 20,000 default; when the config is built from defaults (full-omission create) the None is resolved later by get_indexing_threshold_kb(None) -> DEFAULT_INDEXING_THRESHOLD_KB = 10_000 (lib/shard/src/optimizers/config.rs:15,178). Explicit values take Some(custom) => custom (line 180), matching the D1=20000 and sibling 50000 echoes. Grep for 10_000/20_000/20000 in optimizers_builder.rs, config_diff.rs, config.rs found no 20_000 constant anywhere - there is no code path that would materialize the documented OptimizersConfigDiff default of 20,000; the 10,000 sentence is the only implemented default.
